claims.text: Barber was a named speaker at the 2025 Sol Foundation Symposium, 24-27 October 2025.

The 2025 Sol Foundation Symposium was held 24-27 October 2025 on the shores of Lake Maggiore, northern Italy; speakers included Karl Nell, Jacques Vallee, Garry Nolan, Jake Barber, Dylan Borland, Jeff Nuccetelli, Tim Gallaudet, Diana Pasulka, Beatriz Villarroel and Gen. Pierre Bescond.

edges.label: Michels published Barber's crash-retrieval account
edges.note: Published 30 January 2025 to 1,010,989 views; Barber, a former intelligence officer, described helicopter-borne retrieval. Barber subsequently spoke at the 2025 Sol Foundation Symposium, moving from independent media into the institutional wing.

edges.label: Borland spoke at the 2025 Sol Foundation Symposium
edges.note: Same pipeline: Borland, a former USAF 1N1 geospatial intelligence specialist, appears on the 2025 symposium programme and is subsequently given a three-episode run on American Alchemy in August 2026.

edges.label: Barber spoke at the 2025 Sol Foundation Symposium
edges.note: A whistleblower first platformed by an independent YouTube channel in January 2025 appears on a symposium programme alongside Karl Nell, Jacques Vallee and a retired French general nine months later. The pipeline from independent media to institutional legitimation is short and documented.
